name: Chui
description:
Chui records meetings on an iPhone, an Apple Watch, a Mac or the web, then transcribes and summarises them in the language each meeting was held in. This connector is Chui's text interface: what a person can do by tapping in the app, they can do here by asking.

It searches every transcript, summary, title and note and returns short quoted snippets with the meeting they came from; it reads the summary of one meeting, or its transcript a window at a time; it says how much of a meeting was actually captured; it hands the user a temporary link to listen to their own audio; and it looks up the people in their meetings — how often they met, when they last spoke, and the short standing note Chui keeps about each.

It also writes. It renames a meeting, puts a name to a speaker, asks for a fresh summary, corrects what Chui knows about a person, shares a meeting or stops sharing it, sets reminders and privacy, connects and disconnects a calendar, and manages devices and sign-in methods.

Anything that destroys something — deleting a meeting, folding two people into one entry, removing a colleague — takes two steps. Chui first names exactly what would go, and the second step accepts only a token bound to that one thing, so nothing is ever destroyed that the user was not shown by name first. Nothing here can start or stop a recording: that needs a device with a microphone in the room.

A Chui account with recordings in it is required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Chui to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Chui to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.chui.io/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Chui MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Chui provides these MCP tools: get_audio_link, get_meeting, get_person, get_transcript, list_meetings, list_people, search_meetings, and update_person.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Chui?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Chui in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Chui requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Chui is developed by Generative Chaos LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
